name: Nextcloud
description: Your own cloud: file sync for desktop and phone, sharing links, calendar, contacts and office apps.
notes: Database: MariaDB, host 'db', user 'nextcloud', password ${SECRET}, database 'nextcloud'. They are pre-filled; just create your admin account on first visit.
compose:
services:
  db:
    image: mariadb:11
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: --transaction-isolation=READ-COMMITTED
    environment:
      - MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=${SECRET}
      - MARIADB_DATABASE=nextcloud
      - MARIADB_USER=nextcloud
      - MARIADB_PASSWORD=${SECRET}
    volumes:
      - ./db:/var/lib/mysql
  redis:
    image: redis:alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
  app:
    image: nextcloud:stable
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on: [db, redis]
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    environment:
      - MYSQL_HOST=db
      - MYSQL_DATABASE=nextcloud
      - MYSQL_USER=nextcloud
      - MYSQL_PASSWORD=${SECRET}
      - REDIS_HOST=redis
      - NEXTCLOUD_TRUSTED_DOMAINS=${HOST} ${HOSTNAME} ${HOSTNAME}.local
      - PHP_UPLOAD_LIMIT=16G
    volumes:
      - ./html:/var/www/html
